title: Extensions
intro: External programs that react to GoRun hooks over signed HTTP and call back through the REST API.
install.title: Install an extension
install.help: Upload a .zip containing manifest.json (and an optional assets/ folder), at most %d MB.
install.failed: The package could not be installed:
available.title: Found in the extensions folder
col.name: Extension
reveal.title: Extension installed: copy these now
reveal.help: They are shown only once and cannot be recovered. Configure them in the extension, then activate it.
reveal.secret_help: Verifies the X-GoRun-Signature header of every delivery.
reveal.key_help: Lets the extension call the REST API, limited to the permissions in its manifest.
error.title: Delivery stopped after %d consecutive failures. Fix the endpoint, then re-activate.
error.no_owner: No active administrator can own the extension's API key.

perms.help: The extension's API key carries exactly these scopes and never exceeds its owner's role.
types.title: Content types
links.title: Links
uninstall.title: Uninstall
uninstall.help: Removes the extension and revokes its API key. Its content types, content and settings are kept unless you also purge.
uninstall.purge: Also delete its content types, all their content, its settings and package files (cannot be undone)
validation.slug: Use 2–41 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter.
validation.slug_taken: An extension with this slug is already installed.
validation.version: Use a semantic version such as 1.2.3.
validation.hook_kind: Hook kind must be action, filter or event.
validation.timeout: Timeout must be between 0 and 10000 ms.
validation.endpoint_url: The endpoint must be an http(s) URL.
validation.endpoint_private: Private network endpoints are not allowed (set GORUN_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NET=1 to allow them).
validation.url: Use a /path or an http(s) URL.
validation.type_taken: A content type with this slug already exists.
validation.type_duplicate: This content type is declared twice.
validation.setting_type: Settings may be text, textarea, number, boolean or select.

package.unsafe_path: The package contains an unsafe path.
